annotations.title: Change DNS records (domain stays on Scopeweb)

description: Changes DNS records on a domain this account registered on Scopeweb, so the name serves an app or site hosted anywhere. The domain and its DNS stay on Scopeweb: this edits records in the zone Scopeweb already hosts, and no nameserver move is ever needed. For when the user wants their domain to point at something, including a hosting provider's custom-hostname setup that asks for a CNAME plus TXT verification records. Send a target (a hostname, which is pointed at by CNAME on www by default, or an IPv4 or IPv6 address, which sets A or AAAA on the apex and www), or exact records (A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT on any name, including underscore names such as _acme-challenge). Records the request does not name are kept. The apex cannot be a CNAME; apex: "redirect_to_www" points it at Scopeweb's redirect host, which answers with a permanent redirect to the www name of the same domain over HTTPS, and says so plainly when that host is not running. Every write is read back and compared before it is reported done, and returns a change_id; sending revert with that id restores the records from before it. Cannot spend money.

apex.description: redirect_to_www sends the bare domain to the www name of the same domain, over HTTPS.

domain.description: A domain this account registered on Scopeweb.

hosts.description: Names to point at the target, such as @ for the apex, www, or app. Only with target.

records.description: Exact records to set. Each replaces any record of the same type at the same name; every other record is kept.

name.description: @ for the apex, or a label such as www or _cf-custom-hostname.

remove.description: Records to delete. Without a value, every record of that type at that name goes.

revert.description: A change_id from an earlier change on this domain. Restores the records from before it.

target.description: Where to point: a hostname (CNAME on www by default), or an IPv4 or IPv6 address (A or AAAA on the apex and www by default).

name: point_domain
